newsitem.title: UK: UK Labour's Blair says Britain can do better.
newsitem.headline: UK Labour's Blair says Britain can do better.

text.p: Britain's leader of the opposition Tony Blair said on Monday the country could do better and the forthcoming election would be fought on the issues of education, health and jobs.

"I believe Britain can do better than this. We can have better schools, better hospitals, less violent crime in our streets, better jobs and industry in the future," he told Independent Television News (ITN) in an interview.
"That's what the debate is going to be about" he added.
The election will be held on May 1.
In an interview with Sky Television, he called the ruling Conservatives "rather incompetent, rather tired and offering poor leadership for the country".
